description: Provider claims → verification parameters. Each key is a canonical specification. `aliases` normalise keys the provider used in `specifications`; `patterns` (case-insensitive) also extract the claim from the name/description/features when it was only written in text — group 1 (and 2 if present) form the value. `onlyCategories` limits where a claim applies (e.g. a bare '128GB' is storage only on phones and tablets). `mergeInto` attaches the claim to an existing library parameter instead of adding a new one. `attribute` also sets an extracted attribute used by conditional checks. Placeholders: {value}, {where}.

whereToLook.laptop: the operating system's About / System Information screen, or the BIOS/UEFI setup screen
whereToLook.projector: the projector's information or service menu
whereToLook.vehicle: the registration certificate and the vehicle itself
whereToLook.default: the item's label, nameplate, settings or documentation

cpu.title: Processor
cpu.instruction: Read the processor name in {where} and compare it with the claim.

ram.title: RAM
ram.instruction: Read the installed memory in {where} and compare it with the claim.

storage.title: Storage Capacity
storage.instruction: Read the total storage capacity in {where} (formatted capacity is slightly below the marketed figure) and compare it with the claim.

battery_health.title: Battery Health
battery_health.instruction: Read the battery's maximum capacity on the device's battery health screen or system report and compare it with the claim.

battery_cycles.title: Battery Cycle Count
battery_cycles.instruction: Read the battery cycle count in {where} and compare it with the claim.

display_size.title: Screen Size
display_size.instruction: Measure the screen diagonally (visible area) and compare with the claim, or confirm from {where}.

resolution.title: Display Resolution
resolution.instruction: Confirm the native resolution in {where} and compare it with the claim.

operating_system.title: Operating System
operating_system.instruction: Read the operating system and version in {where} and compare it with the claim.

gpu.title: Graphics
gpu.instruction: Read the graphics adapter in {where} and compare it with the claim.

touchscreen.title: Touchscreen
touchscreen.instruction: Confirm whether the screen responds to touch and compare with the claim.

seating_capacity.title: Seating Capacity
seating_capacity.instruction: Count usable seats with belts and compare with the claim and the registration certificate.

transmission.title: Transmission
transmission.instruction: Confirm the transmission type from the gear selector and registration documents.

fuel_type.title: Fuel Type
fuel_type.instruction: Confirm the fuel type on the registration certificate and fuel filler label.

odometer.title: Odometer Reading
odometer.instruction: Read the odometer and compare it with the claim.

model_year.title: Model / Registration Year
model_year.instruction: Confirm the year on the registration certificate or nameplate and compare it with the claim.

material.title: Material
material.instruction: Inspect exposed surfaces and compare the material with the claim.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.instruction: Measure the item and compare the dimensions with the claim.

rated_output.title: Rated Output / Power
rated_output.instruction: Read the rating on the nameplate and compare it with the claim.

brightness_lumens.title: Brightness (Lumens)
brightness_lumens.instruction: Confirm the rated brightness on the model label or datasheet for the identified model.

megapixels.title: Sensor Resolution
megapixels.instruction: Confirm the sensor resolution for the identified model from its menu or a test image's metadata.

shutter_count.title: Shutter Count
shutter_count.instruction: Read the shutter count and compare it with the claim.

color.title: Colour
color.instruction: Confirm the colour or finish matches the claim.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.instruction: Count every unit and compare with the claim.
